top_retrieved_context.snippet: Cavaliers without starting five vs. Mavericks after flight delay. The Cavaliers were without their entire starting lineup Saturday against the Mavericks after four players were ruled out following travel difficulties.
Nae'Qwan Tomlin F Nov 16 Out Oct 20: Tomlin is set to miss several weeks with a lower back stress reaction, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.
Sam Merrill G Nov 16 Out Nov 10: Merrill (elbow) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.
Evan Mobley C Nov 16 Out Nov 14: Mobley (toe) has been ruled out for Saturday's meeting with Dallas.
Donovan Mitchell G Nov 16 Out Nov 14: Mitchell (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Mavericks.
Jarrett Allen C Nov 16 Out Nov 14: Allen (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Mavericks.
Peyton Watson G Nov 16 Out Nov 14: Watson (hamstring) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Mavericks.
Caleb Wilson F Dec 13 Out Nov 12: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
